findings.reservation: Neither Assault Trooper nor its plural appears in the complete extracted ME3 manual. The Phantom entry on p.25 concerns a different named enemy and does not establish an Assault Trooper identity, role, model or kit. General Cerberus-defense tips on p.24 do not establish the individual model.

findings.shortQuote: Marauders buff Husks and Cannibals by giving them armored plating.
verifiedSmallFacts: It says Marauders grant armored plating to Husks and Cannibals and recommends taking out the Marauder first.
findings.reservation: This is a direct named reference, not an indirect-page reservation. It does not certify the prototype statistics, weapon, timing, visual model, full kit or every faction/species claim.

verifiedSmallFacts: The Cannibal entry on p.24 says Cannibals form armored plating by reclaiming fallen Cannibals and Husks.
The Marauder entry on p.25 says Husks and Cannibals receive armored plating from Marauders.
findings.reservation: Husks are named within other enemy entries; there is no standalone Husk tactics entry in this manual. These statements establish named existence and those interactions only, not a complete Husk role, melee kit, animation, source-model identity or prototype values.

findings.shortQuote: Brutes are vicious opponents that can instantly kill you.
verifiedSmallFacts: A standalone Brute entry warns not to let a Brute get close and says Brutes can instantly kill the player.
findings.reservation: The manual supports that limited close-range danger statement. It does not establish the full original moveset, prototype strike formula, speed, resistances, health, exact appearance or complete behavior.

findings.shortQuote: Stop a Banshee when she becomes charged by damaging her while she uses biotic jumps to close in.
verifiedSmallFacts: A standalone Banshee entry describes biotic jumps used to close the distance and damaging her during those jumps to stop her when charged.
findings.reservation: This is limited named behavior evidence. No complete teleport/control/instant-kill kit, prototype values, timings, appearance or full model fidelity is certified.

Lancer and Suppressor are absent from the complete extracted ME3 manual. The generic thermal-clip discussion on pp.23/26 does not establish the named Lancer or its heat/recharge mechanism, DLC availability or model. A secondary page titled M-11 Suppressor cannot be represented as a direct primary Lancer reference.

Neither Destroyer nor Assembler appears in the complete extracted 30-page MEA manual. P.11 names Remnant devices/consoles and hostile-turret control; p.14 names Remnant research data. Neither passage identifies a Destroyer or establishes its individual role, faction attribution, weapon, phases or appearance. General enemy health/shields on p.17 and multiplayer enemies on pp.26/29 are not individual-model evidence.
